## Token.toUsd() method

Quotes an amount of tokens in USD (scaled by WAD). Returns `undefined` iff the token's price is undefined.

**Signature:**

```typescript
toUsd(amount: bigint, rounding?: RoundingDirection): bigint | undefined;
```
